info.name: Jutge API E2E
info.description:
Full E2E multi-actor collection for the Jutge API.

Groups:
- 0: Setup accounts
- 1: Professor creates resources
- 2: Good student achieves AC
- 3: Bad student gets WA
- 4: Security checks (student actions on teacher-only endpoints must return 403)
- 5: Integrity check after malicious actions

Run with Newman:
  newman run jutge_e2e.postman_collection.json --delay-request 3000

For submission file paths, update sumOkCodePath / sortOkCodePath / etc. variables
or set them to absolute paths of the .c files in dev-tools/postman/.
